description: Drama Studio writers room: turn a one-line premise into a short-drama season: a character bible (1-4 original fictional characters: name, role, look) and 2-8 episode scripts, each with a title, a logline, a script and a "cliffhangerLine". The cliffhanger is SPOKEN: the script's last sentence is exactly "cliffhangerLine" (an open hook for every episode but the last; a payoff plus one lingering question for the last), the first sentence is a hook and the next episode picks the hook up. Each script is already sized to pass autoshort_quote_character_episode (30-60 seconds of narration); an episode that could not be made to fit comes back with needsEditing: true and the exact limit in `issue`. FREE: it spends no credits, starts nothing and saves nothing (it is limited per hour). Characters are always original fictional adults, animals, robots or mascots; real people, brands and sexual or graphic content are refused. Next steps: autoshort_create_series (paused) with the main character as characterDescription, autoshort_create_character_sheet, then autoshort_save_season_plan (the whole season: cast, voice, style, every episode), review it, get the customer's yes and confirm it; only then autoshort_quote_character_episode and autoshort_create_character_episode per episode.

genre.description: drama, thriller, comedy, horror or romance.

language.description: Language code of the scripts, such as 'en' or 'vi'. Default 'en'.

premise.description: The story in one to three sentences: who, what they want, what goes wrong.

name: autoshort_plan_drama_season
